title: Q8
description:
Read: Exo 24:3-8, Lev 14:4-7, Num 19:6, Num 19:18

Blood is sprinkled on the altar and on the people after they take the words. Water, scarlet, and hyssop belong to the leper and to the heifer, not to that day.

a) What does the covenant day itself contribute, and what is gathered in from rites that day did not contain?
